name: Back of Beyond
detailed_description:
"Every transaction is a blessing from the Eldritch God. Miss the deal, miss the divine grace." - Merchant of Mist Town

Welcome to Mist Town - A Village Chosen by the Eldritch Gods

As the new acting mayor of this fog-shrouded town, navigate the thin line between devotion and madness. Every follower and building is crucial in your battle against mysterious forces.

Build Your Cult Empire

  • Deploy buildings and followers strategically to create optimal resource combinations

  • Manage diverse followers from housewives and students to war veterans

  • Operate unique facilities: from souvenir shops to abyss caves

Deep Strategic Gameplay

  • Master building mechanics: white buildings accept all followers, while special buildings require matching colored followers

  • Utilize follower abilities: blue followers excel at wealth creation, red followers focus on faith

  • Face Eldritch Deity checks every five turns, where your decisions shape the town's destiny

Dark and Mysterious World

  • Manage your town amidst eerie landscapes of geothermal springs and swamps

  • Confront four powerful deities: from the basic Dark Spirit to the fearsome Mist Wizard

  • Experience twisted narratives: each follower has a story, every building holds secrets

Key Features

  • Meticulously crafted turn-based strategy

  • Haunting dark art style

  • Rich combinations of buildings and followers

  • Tense resource management system

  • Unique deity check mechanism

In Back of Beyond, face choices between morality and madness. As the acting mayor, are you ready to begin your reign in this fog-enshrouded town?

short_description: In this dark turn-based strategy game, rule a mysterious town as its acting mayor. Deploy buildings and followers to gather faith and money while facing eldritch deity checks. Build your cult empire on the edge of devotion and madness.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 730 or Radeon HD 4830
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650 or Radeon HD 7750
